title: thymus loevyanus var. bracteatus
intro: Thymus loevyanus var. bracteatus, commonly known as the "Mountain Thyme" or "Bracted Thyme", is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is rich in medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can aid in wound healing, reducing fever, and protecting against various infections. The therapeutic actions of Thymus loevyanus var. bracteatus include its ability to exhibit expectorant and spasmolytic properties, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and gastrointestinal problems. The plant's bioactive constituents include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
